title: Figure 3: Numeric probability density function of N from the Statistical Drake equation
description: Small plot titled 'PROBABILITY DENSITY FUNCTION OF N', with probability density (0 to 4x10^-4) versus 'N = Number of ET Civilizations in Galaxy' (0-4000). Captioned 'Figure 3. The numeric (and not analytic) probability density function curve f_N(y) of the number N of ExtraTerrestrial Civilizations in the Galaxy according to the Statistical Drake equation (3).' The page continues into section '5. The Central Limit Theorem (CLT) of Statistics' with equations (44)-(47).
